native_lab.rule: Pinned deterministic ChemBench parser, without model extraction fallback; sorted distinct tagged values, then native plain-letter/comma/space fallback.

unambiguous_lab.rule: Exactly one distinct in-range single-letter tag value; repeated identical single-letter tags permitted. Multiple distinct values, multi-letter tag, malformed/mismatched tags or out-of-range tags invalid. Plain fallback only an exact raw single in-range uppercase letter. No reasoning text, similarity or reference-guided extraction.

p03.rule: Native strict ten-class 0-9 whole-visible-final parser, case insensitive.

failure_policy: Every planned case retained. Transport/HTTP errors, refusals, truncations, non-completed responses, missing final text and ambiguous strict outputs score incorrect. No selective replacement. Native parser is preserved separately from this explicit delivery-failure rule.
abstention_policy: A valid explicit insufficient-information option is parsed, usable abstention; not a missing answer. Native non-abstention coverage is not usable-answer rate.

uncertainty.grouping: Use scorer-only group_id for cluster resampling only when complete on every selected case; otherwise require explicit case-level scope. Fixed one-generation paired benchmark, not independent biological experiments or across-run model variance.
